details:
Q1. What specifically should be improved?
Choices:
A. A GitHub Actions workflow or pipeline phase in this repo (RECOMMENDED)
B. A script or automation helper in this repo
C. Repository documentation or onboarding experience
D. Something else in the repo (please name the file, workflow, or feature)
Q2. Which concrete part of the repository is in scope?
Choices:
A. Clarify / Plan / Implement pipeline behavior
B. Review autofix / conflict resolution behavior
C. Orchestrator / judge / validation behavior
D. A specific file, workflow, or script you will name explicitly (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or broken behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / reduce failures / handle edge cases
C. Improve performance / reduce API calls / reduce runtime
D. Improve UX / logs / comments / notifications / documentation
Q4. How should we judge success?
Choices:
A. Match a specific expected behavior you describe with an example (RECOMMENDED)
B. Resolve a specific current error, failure mode, or flaky workflow run
C. Make a measurable improvement to runtime, API usage, or noise
D. Apply a general cleanup only, with no specific behavior change
Q5. Are there any constraints or non-goals we must preserve?
Choices:
A. Keep behavior backward compatible unless absolutely necessary (RECOMMENDED)
B. Do not change workflow filenames, labels, or public automation contracts
C. Do not touch `.github/workflows` files
D. No special constraints beyond the requested improvement
